    f.write('    fn parse_primary(&mut self) -> Result<ast::Expression> {\n')

    f.write('                }\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('            Token::Number(n) => {\n')
    f.write('                if n.contains(\'.\') || n.contains(\'e\') || n.contains(\'E\') {\n')
    f.write('                    Ok(ast::Expression::Literal(ast::Literal::Float(n.parse()?)))\n')
    f.write('                } else {\n')
    f.write('                    Ok(ast::Expression::Literal(ast::Literal::Integer(n.parse()?)))\n')
    f.write('                }\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('            Token::String(s) => Ok(ast::Expression::Literal(ast::Literal::String(s))),\n')
    f.write('            Token::Keyword(Keyword::Null) => Ok(ast::Expression::Literal(ast::Literal::Null)),\n')
    f.write('            Token::Keyword(Keyword::True) => Ok(ast::Expression::Literal(ast::Literal::Boolean(true))),\n')
    f.write('            Token::Keyword(Keyword::False) => Ok(ast::Expression::Literal(ast::Literal::Boolean(false))),\n')
    f.write('            Token::Keyword(Keyword::NaN) => Ok(ast::Expression::Literal(ast::Literal::Float(f64::NAN))),\n')
    f.write('            Token::Keyword(Keyword::Infinity) => Ok(ast::Expression::Literal(ast::Literal::Float(f64::INFINITY))),\n')
    f.write('            Token::Minus => {\n')
    f.write('                let expr = self.parse_primary()?;\n')
    f.write('                Ok(ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Negate(Box::new(expr))))\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('            Token::Plus => {\n')
    f.write('                let expr = self.parse_primary()?;\n')
    f.write('                Ok(ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Identity(Box::new(expr))))\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('            Token::Keyword(Keyword::Not) => {\n')
    f.write('                let expr = self.parse_primary()?;\n')
    f.write('                Ok(ast::Expression::Operator(ast::Operator::Not(Box::new(expr))))\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('            Token::OpenParen => {\n')
    f.write('                if let Some(Token::Ident(name)) = self.peek()?.cloned() {\n')
    f.write('                    self.next();\n')
    f.write('                    self.expect(Token::OpenParen)?;\n')
    f.write('                    let mut args = Vec::new();\n')
    f.write('                    if !self.next_is(Token::CloseParen) {\n')
    f.write('                        loop {\n')
    f.write('                            args.push(self.parse_expression()?);\n')
    f.write('                            if !self.next_is(Token::Comma) {\n')
    f.write('                                break;\n')
    f.write('                            }\n')
    f.write('                        }\n')
    f.write('                    }\n')
    f.write('                    self.expect(Token::CloseParen)?;\n')
    f.write('                    Ok(ast::Expression::Function(name, args))\n')
    f.write('                } else {\n')
    f.write('                    let expr = self.parse_expression()?;\n')
    f.write('                    self.expect(Token::CloseParen)?;\n')
    f.write('                    Ok(expr)\n')
    f.write('                }\n')
    f.write('            }\n')
    f.write('            other => errinput!("unexpected token in expression: {}", other),\n')
    f.write('        }\n')
    f.write('    }\n')
    f.write('}\n')
print('Done')
